behavior: `Accordion.Root`, `ToggleGroup` and `CheckboxGroup` read `null` in `value` as an empty array, and the part stays controlled. A press emits the change with the value of the item, and the part keeps the value of the parent. A change of `value` to `null` empties the part, and the part does not show `defaultValue`. A form reset does not change a `CheckboxGroup` whose `value` is `null`, and it emits nothing. `defaultValue` reads `null` as an empty array too. Vue accepts `null` for an optional prop with no warning, so a `v-model:value` whose ref becomes `null` gives `null` to the part. Base UI throws a `TypeError` for a `null` `value`: `Accordion.Root` and `CheckboxGroup` at the render, and `ToggleGroup` with `multiple` at a press. Without `multiple`, `ToggleGroup` of Base UI reads `null` as an empty array, as Vase UI does.
